purpose: Requirement 7: record and hash-seal ALL startup context that auto-loads into a custom agent, so no false blindness is claimed for context that cannot be removed or sealed. The canary IS exposed to the sealed items below; blindness is claimed ONLY for what the hooks mechanically exclude (other lanes, .git, /root/.claude, /proc, env, transcripts).

project_memory.note: Project CLAUDE.md (the LAWMAX creator contract) auto-loads into agents in this repo. The canary is NOT blind to it. Sealed here so its content is fixed and auditable.

user_memory.note: ABSENT in this environment at seal time.

managed_policy_instructions.note: None discovered as a readable on-disk file at seal time; ~/.claude/launcher-settings.json is settings (hooks/permissions), not context injected into the agent. If the platform injects managed/system instructions not present on disk, they cannot be hashed here — declared as an UNSEALABLE residue, not as blindness.

sealed_meaning: PASS may claim only that the canary could not READ the mechanically-excluded targets. It may NOT claim the canary had an empty/blind context: at minimum the project CLAUDE.md above is in its context.
verify: In the fresh session, re-hash CLAUDE.md and .claude/agents/lane-blind-reader.md before the run; a mismatch invalidates this seal and the run.
